title: Hard parades: the Hobgoblins and the Jackson City Bulls
summary: Rene recalls playing grueling street parades, including Halloween Hobgoblins and a white club that marched long distances.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I played so many parades, you know? So many parades, and them parades was hard at them times, you know? Because we used to play the Bulls, they don't have a parade, they're going out existing. The Hobgoblins, you ever heard of them? He used to go on a Halloween night. Well, them fellas used to go from Carlton down to the, I think one of the hardest parades they got right now is what, this club up there, the white club up there?
